articles.title: Veruschka obituary
articles.summary: German model and artist whose bold and dynamic shoots made her one of the biggest stars of 1960s fashion. The aspiring model Vera von Lehndorff created “Veruschka” – little Vera – as a memorable alternative persona whose existence was performance art.
body: She used her natural resources: a 6ft-plus-tall body that, horizontal, could fill an entire glossy magazine spread; a face with magnificent bone architecture and feline eyes; and a long mane that was amenable to brutal short cuts and extraordinary coiffures. All were animated by her instinct for making shapes in air – not a model’s poses but a dancer’s movements that only a click of the lens could catch. Watch her seducing the camera of the photographer, played by David Hemmings, in Michelangelo Antonioni ’s 1966 film Blow Up to see her original act in action.
points: German model and artist whose bold and dynamic shoots made her one of the biggest stars of 1960s fashion.

articles.summary: Reformation’s Black Friday sale is here. Vogue edits the standout dresses, jackets and skirts from the sale, which offers 25% off across the site.
body: Hailed as a go-to among both celebrities and It-girls, LA-based fashion brand Reformation is best known for its well-considered mix of hardworking wardrobe staples, stylish accessories and versatile eveningwear. Its designs are reliably trend-led, yet there’s a timeless quality to the collections too; pieces feel current without being so tied to a particular moment that they’ll date by next season. Since launching in 2009, Reformation has built a loyal following for good reason— from its much-loved denim and everyday separates to its occasionwear, which has become a fixture on the party circuit.

articles.title: Models Off-Duty Love a Salmon Sneaker—Black Friday 2026 Lets You Get a Pair for Less
articles.summary: It’s no secret the model off-duty set loves a comfy shoe, with Salomon sneakers being one of their top choices—get a pair for less this Black Friday.
body: You don’t need us to tell you that Salomon sneakers are perfect for low-key weekend looks. You will, however, appreciate us scoping out a few on sale this Black Friday.

For years, Salomon’s rugged trail hikers were reserved for outdoorsy pursuits; they’ve become mainstays in a modern everyday wardrobe (particularly those of models off-duty ) for a few reasons, chief among them their sporty look, which signals a cool readiness for whatever the day may bring. It certainly helps, too, that the shoe’s main design features—a grippy sole, a waterproof upper, and a quick-lace system—all allow for easy, versatile wear no matter the weather.

But it’s not just models who love this particular sneaker: designer Jonathan Anderson has made Salomon sneakers an integral part of his uniform, which typically consists of straight-leg Levi’s, a simple crew-neck sweater—often in navy blue or green—and a white T-shirt peeking out just below the collar. (When Anderson’s not in a knit, you can find him in a plaid button-down.) Many stylish A-listers—including Emily Ratajkowski, Kendall Jenner, and Jennifer Lawrence—have also sported the shoe on off-duty days.

articles.title: Breville Oracle Jet Review: This Beginner-Friendly Espresso Machine Is $200 Off Right Now
articles.summary: If you dream of pulling pro-level espresso shots and perfecting your latte art, listen up.
body: I’ve had quite a few dreams and aspirations in my adult life thus far. One of them was owning an espresso machine. As someone who would typically choose a cappuccino over a cup of drip coffee, the idea of waking up every morning and enjoying the perfect mug of milky espresso from the comfort of my own home seemed like the pinnacle of luxury.

The Oracle Jet is about as close to a super-automatic machine as you can get without actually being super-automatic. That is to say, you still have to complete a few steps along the way to your latte.

After unboxing my machine on its arrival, I was delighted to find that there was no need to flip through a physical manual. The entire setup process was explained (very clearly, I’ll add) via the touchscreen display, and the steps were laid out in a logical order, which I really appreciated.
